document_title: GENQUANTAA Academy — FICTIONAL Classroom Assignment Policy
status: Fictional demo only — not an official GENQUANTAA Academy policy

sections.heading: Practice assignment deadline
sections.text: In this fictional classroom example, weekly practice assignments are due by Sunday at 6:00 PM IST following the class week.

sections.heading: Late submissions
sections.text: Late practice assignments may be accepted up to 48 hours after the deadline, but only with trainer approval. Late acceptance is not automatic.

sections.heading: Class recordings
sections.text: For this fictional classroom example, class recordings are made available within 24 hours after the session.

sections.heading: Student support
sections.text: Students should bring practical questions to their trainer during the next scheduled doubt-clearing session.

boundaries: This fictional policy does not specify course fees, certification criteria, placement guarantees, contact phone numbers, or real dates.
